title: Reduction size
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols and natural numbers $d,c$, define the size at input length $n$ to be $3w^2+3w$, where $w=vwid(wCoef(N,d),c+1,n)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
